title: Australia Superdraw, American jackpots and El Gordo are primed!
heading: Weekend Lottery Roundup
description: Find amazing opportunities to explore for our lottery spend this week. The long awaited Australian Superdraw has arrived. American jackpots continues to climb. And Spain's El Gordo Christmas lottery is open for business.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
Luck be in the air. We have amazing opportunities to explore for our lottery spend this week. The long-awaited Australian Superdraw has arrived. American Jackpots continue to climb. And the fantastic El Gordo Christmas lottery is now available on Lotto Express for pre-orders.

Australian Superdraw has arrived

The Australia 6/45 draw on October 21 arrives with a guaranteed Jackpot of $20 Million. Lottery enthusiasts around the world are eagerly anticipating this not-to-be-missed event.

Australian Superdraws are rare occurrences, adding to the excitement and anticipation, where a special SUPER-SIZED minimum jackpot is guaranteed.

Unlike regular draws, the pre-scheduled Australian Superdraw offers a minimum guaranteed jackpot regardless of whether there was a carryover from the preceding draw.

Don’t miss out on this fantastic opportunity.

American Powerball and Mega Mega Millions keep climbing

There’s no time to lose with both major American lotteries featuring big number jackpots.

American Mega Millions has almost reached 9 figures. Get your plays in quickly to play for a $91 Million jackpot this Friday night.

Saturday’s American Powerball jackpot is ready for a new jackpot winner at any moment and it could be you. Play for the $70 million American Powerball jackpot this Saturday.

The American Dream is alive and well at LottoExpress.com!

The Spanish Christmas Lottery Extravaganza is open for business

Every year at Christmas time, Spain’s El Gordo awards more prize money than any raffle in the world. You can now reserve your entry at Lotto Express.

Overall, 2.5 Billion Euros will be won. Play for your share now.

Check it out and get into the action!

Good Luck everybody on your weekend plays.
